thread:
jamie-sre: Quick postmortem follow-up. We surfaced 5 follow-ups that touch SLOs and dashboards. Need clear owners, acceptance criteria, and firm dates.
elaine-ml: I can take model routing + fallback policy. Will draft behavior: on sustained p99 > 900ms for 4m, route to quantized variant and mark request header.
tony-oncall: I'll own runbook and alert tuning. Plan: add a new alert for p99 anomaly + burn-rate, update runbook steps, test failover in staging.
sophia-platform: I'll own dashboard + customer SLA doc updates. Need exact metrics and a proposed SLO delta to present at leadership sync.
lee-telemetry: I'll add incident markers and a diff view. Also proposing a weekly smoke-run against the top 20 tenant prompts to detect regressions.
jamie-sre: Proposed SLO changes: hosted standard p95 from 320ms -> 280ms; add throughput SLO for batch endpoints: average QPS >= X during peak (we'll define X). Agree?
elaine-ml: 280ms seems aggressive. Can we present a tiered SLO: 280ms for pinned-dedicated customers, 320ms for shared-hosted? That keeps SLAs realistic while pushing perf.
sophia-platform: Tiered SLO sounds good. I'll draft wording: "Hosted (shared): p95 <= 320ms, Dedicated: p95 <= 280ms." Will include a note about bursty embedding workloads and potential throttling.
tony-oncall: Runbook acceptance criteria: documented steps + DR test in staging + measured failover latency < 500ms. Target: prototype within 4 business days.
lee-telemetry: Dashboard plan: panels for p50/p95/p99 per model and per-tenant QPS, error-budget burn-rate gauge, and a recurrence heatmap. Query sketch:
```
select model, tenant_id, quantile(0.95)(latency_ms) as p95, count() as qps
from requests
where env='prod' and time > now() - 1h
group by model, tenant_id
```
Alert rule: burn_rate > 1.5 for 30m OR p99 > 1s for 5m.
jamie-sre: infra-bot: create ticket for the sprint and set due date for full remediation in 14 days.
infra-bot: ticket #RWD-4333 opened: "SLO remediation sprint - dashboards, runbook, telemetry, model routing" assigned to jamie-sre, due 2026-04-14. link: https://tickets.example/RWD-4333
sophia-platform: Acceptance criteria to add to ticket: SLA PR merged, grafana panels live, alert tests green, runbook merged and staged failover tested, telemetry job running nightly.
elaine-ml: Long-term item: tenant-level rate limiter or dedicated capacity offering for heavy embedding tenants. Adding to backlog and tagging product/solutions.
lee-telemetry: I'll also add a recurring regression job and attach sample diffs to the ticket.
tony-oncall: Timeline summary: SLO proposal to leadership in 5 business days, runbook prototype in 4 days, dashboards in 6 days, full remediation sweep in 14 days.
jamie-sre: Great. I'll update the postmortem with owners + ticket link and schedule a 20-min check-in in 48h. If anyone has blockers, flag here. :thumbsup:
